LanguageData.BOR_MedicineII.label: first kwaed kit
LanguageData.BOR_MedicineII.description: A kit of medical supplies so advanced they can almost perform surgeries on their own, though not without pop-up ads. It contains quasimorphic drug synthesizers, microsecond coagulant agents, a wireless medical scanner and handheld vitals monitor, and two emergency cyanide pills.
